title: feat(console): phone Home folds the setup checklist to one line after the apps; the phone bar's badge and title fit
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBXim82sEGBUBXqH4hkWyBJX)_
Fixes #34596
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzi3ezPzTysQPDEjmVz (claim 6937591453, surface amended by the seat to add `InboxPopover.tsx`) · part of epic #34571

**Item 2 of the card (no floating AI button on a phone) is handed to #34608**, which removes the in-app AI button at every width under the ruling on #34608 (comment 6937495221: "the in-app bottom-right AI button is removed (one entry: the top-bar robot)"); it lands in PR #34665. This PR does not touch `ConsoleChatbotFab.tsx`.

**Deviation from card item 3's wording.** Item 3 asks for a phone bar with "search, notifications, avatar" only. The phone bar keeps the top-bar AI robot (where the server serves AI) under the #34608 ruling (comment 6937495221: "one entry: the top-bar robot"), which postdates the card's wording; with the in-app AI button gone (#34665, now on `main`), hiding the robot on a phone would leave a phone with no AI entry. Live reading with the robot's 44 px slot in the bar: the phone title gets 89 px and "Opportunities" needs 89 px, so it fits (89/89 px, not truncated; 74/89 px and truncated on the old `main`).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：手机宽度（768 px 以下）首页的「初始化清单」挪到应用宫格之后，默认折叠成一行（标题、进度、「继续」），点「继续」原地展开，展开后可再收起；手机顶栏的通知角标「9+」移进铃铛的 44 px 点击区内，不再被顶栏上沿裁掉；640 px 以下顶栏三组按钮之间去掉分隔线和额外间距、标题去掉左边距，把宽度让给页面标题。
- 为什么改：375 宽实测改前清单占首屏 90%（375×667）、首屏一行应用图标都看不到；角标顶边在 y = -0.5 px，露在顶栏之外。
- 风险与回滚：只动控制台前端（`HomePage` 新增一个可选的清单插槽、清单组件新增摆放参数、铃铛角标两个手机类名、顶栏手机端间距、每种语言一个「继续」键）；清单的行、完成判定、进度计数、关闭按钮都不变；768 px 及以上首页不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：① `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomePage.tsx` 的 `checklist?.('top')` / `checklist?.('afterApps')` 两处摆放；② `ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/FirstRunChecklist.tsx` 的 `foldable && !unfolded` 折叠分支；③ `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppHeader.tsx` 右侧按钮簇的 `sm:` 分隔线类名。
- 两分钟验证：在仓根执行 `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/FirstRunChecklist.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/console/home/__tests__/HomePage.phoneTapTargets-29147.test.tsx`，预期 2 个文件全部通过（含「375 px: drawn once, after the apps」与「one line: the title, the progress and Continue」）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Home's checklist slot** (`HomePage.tsx`, `@object-ui/app-shell`): `HomePage` takes an optional `checklist(placement)` render slot. Home calls it with `'top'` above the page's sections on a desktop, with `'afterApps'` in the content column right after the apps strip on a phone (`usePhoneViewport`, below 768 px, the hook the list and record pages already use), and with `'top'` above the empty state when there is no app yet. While the page is loading the slot is not drawn, so the checklist mounts once, where it stays. The console's Home route (`App.tsx`) passes the first-run checklist through the slot instead of mounting it above `DefaultHomePage`.

**The folded card** (`FirstRunChecklist.tsx`): a `placement` prop (`'top'` default). `'afterApps'` starts folded to one line: the title, the progress line the card already draws ("3 of 6 done", same count, same key) and a **Continue** button (`aria-expanded=false`). Continue unfolds the whole card in place; the unfolded phone card adds a fold control (chevron, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` = the rows list, named by `common.collapse`) beside the progress and the close button. Folding is the mount's own state, like the done-rows fold: a fresh visit starts folded. No row, completion rule, progress count, write or dismiss record changes; with every required row done the card still draws nothing.

**The phone top bar** (`AppHeader.tsx`, phone bar only; `InboxPopover.tsx`, the badge line only):
- The bell's badge takes `max-md:top-1 max-md:right-1`: below 768 px it sits inside the 44 px trigger on the glyph's corner, instead of 2 px above the trigger, which put its top edge at y = -0.5 px, outside the 48 px bar.
- Below 640 px the utility cluster's group dividers and their margins are `sm:`-scoped, so the 44 px controls sit side by side, and the page title beside the app pill takes no margin of its own (the pill's padding parts them). Both give the width to the title.
- **Which controls the phone bar keeps is unchanged.** On `main` the phone bar already shows only search, the bell and the account menu, plus the AI robot where the server serves AI. The card asks for "search, notifications, avatar" only; the robot stays because the #34608 ruling makes it the one AI entry ("one entry: the top-bar robot"), and with the in-app AI button removed there, hiding it on a phone would leave a phone with no AI entry at all. The card's item 2 also routes the phone AI entry to the top-bar icon.

**i18n**: `console.firstRunChecklist.continue` in all eleven packs (zh-Hant regenerated with `gen-zh-hant.mjs`).

**Why the key is in the eager `locales/en.ts`, not a lazy namespace.** The eager pack is for keys the eager shell draws; a key only lazily loaded surfaces read belongs in the namespace that surface already uses. This key does not qualify for a namespace: `FirstRunChecklist` is a static import of the console entry (`App.tsx`), drawn by the `/home` route, which is where `RootLandingRedirect` lands a workspace by default, and it renders behind no namespace frame. Measured in the built console at `860300c36`: the call site `console.firstRunChecklist.continue` sits in the entry chunk `assets/index-DAb5a3hk.js`, the one chunk `eager-closure.json` lists in `entryChunks`; the rest of the `console.firstRunChecklist` group already lives in `en.ts`. The two pack-shaped namespaces (`marketplace`, `developer`) hold groups their own surfaces read, and `check:i18n-keys` refuses a namespace-only key read outside its frame, so moving this one key there would need a second loader for one string. Cost: `i18n-locale-en` reads **60.2 KB / 60.5 KB** ceiling (headroom 0.4 KB) after merging `main` (see Verification); the ceiling is not touched.

## Tests

- `FirstRunChecklist.test.tsx` (new top-level describe in the existing harness, real settings client on a stubbed `fetch`): the folded line (title, "0 of 5 done", Continue, no rows, no write); Continue unfolds with every row, the fold control's `aria-expanded` / `aria-controls`, folding back; folding changes no completion rule (the folded line counts "3 of 5 done", a set workspace draws nothing); zh 「继续」; CONTROL: `'top'` draws the whole card with neither control.
- `HomePage.phoneTapTargets-29147.test.tsx` (new top-level describe): at 1024 px the slot is asked once for `'top'`, drawn before the greeting and the apps, never `'afterApps'`; at 375 px once for `'afterApps'`, after the last app tile and before "My work"; 375 px with no app: `'top'`; CONTROL: no slot, page as before. The harness also gains the module-top `import '@objectstack/lint'` that `check:test-source-alias` asks of an edited file reaching `capabilityLint`.
- `AppHeader.centeredSearch-12472.test.tsx` (new top-level describe): every divider rule on the cluster is `sm:`- or `min-[960px]:`-scoped; the phone title carries no margin class and sits in the left group.
- `InboxPopover.phoneWidth-29076.test.tsx` (new top-level describe): the "9+" badge carries `max-md:top-1 max-md:right-1` beside its desktop offsets, inside the `relative max-md:size-11` trigger.

No ablation: happy-dom computes no media query, so these pins read the classes and the slot calls; the pixel proof is the live reading below.

## Acceptance notes

- **Robot vs. card wording** (the deviation stated above): kept by ruling. Measured on a phone app route with a 44 px robot slot in the bar: the title has 89 px, "Opportunities" needs 89 px, so it fits with no headroom; on the old `main` the same title had 74 px and truncated. A longer page name still truncates while the robot is in the bar.
- **The bell's pulse.** When the unread count rises the trigger bounces for 1.2 s (`motion-safe:animate-bounce`, 25 % of its height); during that bounce the badge rides above the bar's edge again. Unchanged here.
- **640–767 px.** The badge moves inside from 768 px down; the dividers and the title margin change only below 640 px (the title is drawn only below `sm`).
- **Desktop first screen.** At 1280 × 800 the card is still above the page (48 % of the first screen, one row of app icons): unchanged, out of this card's scope.
- **Clause-②: yes (widening)**, by the seat's ruling in the restated claim on #34596: a new locale key (`console.firstRunChecklist.continue`) and an optional `checklist` prop on the workspace-private app-shell `HomePage` export. L1 at TIER_DEFAULT is the review of record, no L2. `Metadata-protocol: none` and the `patch` level are unchanged; the changeset carries the same two lines.

## Verification

"Before" is the same stack with the five source files restored from `origin/main` (then restored to `HEAD`, each file's hash equal to its `HEAD` blob).

| Phone app-route titles as served ("Expense Reports", "Business Units") | 110/110, 96/96 | 110/110, 96/96 |
| 1280 × 800 Home | card above the page | unchanged |
